cited.quote: accord administrative and financial sanctions for an amount of Rs.1.00 crore
Maximum Rs.10,000/- per pump set electric motor pumpset including GST

rationale: C1 is G.O.Ms.No.6 (2022-01-06) sanctioning Rs.1 crore for Rs.10,000 subsidy on electric motor pumpsets to small and marginal farmers owning up to 3 acres. C2 (GO 259, 2022-11-03) continues it at larger scale. Scope covers replacement as well as new motors, so slightly broader than the 'do not own' wording.

cited.quote: ramps, handrails, braille signage, tactile tiles, renovation in toilets, lifts (23)
Ramp with hand rails are being provided with anti-skid tiles to enter the building.

rationale: C4 is a GO (2021-10-01) releasing grant for accessible works including ramps and toilet renovation in public buildings such as colleges and a library. C1 describes ramps and accessible toilets in PWD-maintained buildings. No extract covers hospitals or bus stops, so only part of the promise is shown. Weak evidence.

cited.quote: Establishment of new Research Centre for Turmeric at Bhavanisagar
The Turmeric Research Station will work on the strategies to increase

rationale: C1 and C3 are GO 236 (2021-12-09) approving and sanctioning a new Turmeric Research Centre at Bhavanisagar, Erode district. It is an official step, but no extract shows the centre operating, and it is a Rs.1-2 crore research centre rather than a state-of-the-art institute. Not yet shown operational.

cited.quote: Industrial Training Institutes under the Training Wing of this Department are providing long-term skill training

rationale: Extracts C1-C5 describe general ITI training, STRIVE and industry tie-ups. None mentions persons with disabilities or subsidised self-employment loans for them. Only related general activity is shown, no official step for this commitment.

cited.quote: mobile vegetable shops will be operated in five Corporations, viz, Chennai, Trichy, Coimbatore, Salem and Tiruppur on a pilot basis
mobile vending vehicles (MaThi Express) are introduced for sale in urban areas

rationale: C3 announces a pilot of 30 mobile vegetable shops with planned subsidy for vehicles, stated in future tense. C1 concerns vehicles for SHG products. Neither introduces mobile marketing permits for farmers. Related activity only.

cited.quote: This Government will also urge that in all Union Government offices including nationalized banks

rationale: C1 (Governor's Address) states an intention to urge the Union Government. No extract shows a formal step such as an Assembly resolution, letter or GO. C2-C3 concern Tamil use in State offices; C4-C5 are unrelated RTI GOs.

cited.quote: 89,429 houses are in progress will be completed by June 2025 and 10,433 individual houses

rationale: C2 reports urban BLC houses under construction under a Union-approved programme. C1 and C3-C4 are reconstruction/repair schemes for damaged houses. None is an official step to complete all partially constructed houses.

cited.quote: offer services including ploughing, seed planting, and harvest at fixed rates for agricultural lands within its control
Cooperative societies of farmers by providing subsidy assistance to purchase 5 Tractors with trailers

rationale: C4 and C5 are GO 201 (2021-11-20) sanctioning SMAM funds, with a proposed custom hiring hub component in which cooperative societies buy machinery and offer ploughing, planting and harvest at fixed rates. It is an official step, but the service is described as proposed and no extract shows it operating.

cited.quote: the Tambaram City Municipal Corporation Ordinance, 2021 (Tamil Nadu Ordinance 5 of 2021)
Tiruvannamalai municipality has been constituted as municipal corporation by merging with 18 village panchayats

rationale: C4 names 2021 city municipal corporation ordinances for Kancheepuram, Karur, Tambaram, Kumbakonam; C2 shows Tiruvannamalai, Pudukkottai and Namakkal constituted as corporations; C3 lists Cuddalore as a corporation. No extract shows Theni-Periyakulam, Karaikudi or Virudhunagar upgraded. Date is only the ordinance year.

cited.quote: Free coaching classes for competitive examinations are conducted in Arts and Science Colleges affiliated to the ten universities
Conducting Coaching Classes for Competitive Examinations through separate Channel for Education of Kalvi Television

rationale: C2 shows coaching at ten universities and study circles in District Employment Centres, long-running and open to all aspirants. C4 is a GO for coaching via Kalvi Television. None sets up coaching centres in every district specifically for women graduates. Related activity only.

cited.quote: enhancing parental annual income ceiling of the family from Rs.2.5 lakhs to Rs.8 lakhs, incentive from Rs.50,000/- to Rs.1,00,000/-
Incentive of Rs.1,00,000/- would be provided to the beneficiaries in 10 monthly installments.

rationale: C5 records G.O.(Ms) No.96 dated 25.11.2021 raising the Ph.D incentive for SC/ST scholars from Rs.50,000 to Rs.1,00,000 and the beneficiary count to 1600; C4 revises guidelines. C1 shows a higher overseas-scholarship income ceiling. Only some scholarships are shown increased, not annual scholarships broadly.

cited.quote: All the essential commodities are supplied to the family cardholders using smart family cards in the Fair Price Shops
Aadhar based smart family cards containing Quick Response (QR) code are issued to the family card holders since

rationale: C2 and C3 show smart family cards were already the norm, issued on Aadhaar since 01.04.2017, before the government took office. Later extracts show new cards issued and printers procured (C4), but no dated step by this government converting existing cards.

cited.quote: The New Health Insurance Scheme 2021 is implemented from 01-07-2021
Under the new scheme, the maximum limit has been enhanced to Rs.10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten lakh)

rationale: C1 and C2 report the New Health Insurance Scheme 2021, implemented from 01-07-2021, with the limit enhanced to Rs.10 lakh for surgeries, transplants and complex procedures, cashless via network hospitals. Private hospital coverage is not explicit, and the date comes from the policy note text.

cited.quote: Establishing Geriatric care in all medical colleges and district Government hospitals
Government of Tamil Nadu has established Geriatric units in 28 Government Medical College Hospitals

rationale: C2 and C3 show geriatric units and 20-bed wards in 31 hospitals under the national programme, described as already established, with no dated step by this government. C4 (GO 59, 2023-09-04) is a senior citizens policy saying geriatric care will be provided in all medical colleges and district hospitals: an official step, not shown operational.

cited.quote: approve the draft Master Plan for Tourism for 300 sites, in Tamil Nadu
Tourism Master Plan will be prepared for providing tourist facilities in international standard in 300 tourist places

rationale: C1 and C2 are G.O.Ms.No.125 dated 21.10.2021, a dedicated GO approving the Tourism Master Plan for 300 destinations, whose objectives include foreign exchange earnings. C5 confirms the department has prepared the plans. Directional commitment met by a dedicated GO; formal public release of the report is not explicit.

cited.quote: The Special Programme Implementation Department will coordinate with line Departments in effective implementation of these initiatives

rationale: C1 and C5 describe a Special Programme Implementation Department that monitors schemes, but they show no GO creating a ministry for new scheme implementation, nor that a senior minister heads it. C2-C4 are unrelated. No official step for this commitment is shown.

cited.quote: Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees five lakhs only) in case of death

rationale: The promise names no specific employee group. C5 shows a Rs.5 lakh ex-gratia for polling personnel, set by an earlier 2013 GO. C1 raises sewer-worker death compensation to Rs.15 lakh; C2 is death gratuity; C4 is Rs.2 lakh accident relief. None is a new Rs.5 lakh employee death award.

cited.quote: Request for Qualification (RFQ) has been floated for three bus depots/bus terminals of MTC
Detailed Project Reports are under preparation for the Integrated Development of Bus terminals at Vadapalani

rationale: C3 reports 12 MTC depots/terminals taken up for modernisation and commercial development, with an RFQ floated for three, a tender step. C1 says DPRs are being prepared for integrated bus terminals; C2 covers modernising bus stands. No integrated bus stand is shown operational.

C1-C2 concern a cyber crisis management plan, C3 a COVID war room, C4 a Governor's address with no such request, and C5 a state chemical accident crisis group. None is about urging the Union government to establish a Crisis Management Centre for conflict resolution.

cited.quote: Publicly available Dashboard to track progress of grievances

rationale: C5 describes an online grievance platform with a public dashboard in a 2023 strategy GO. It does not provide display of complaint status or MLA/MP demands at Collector, Councillor or BDO offices. C1-C4 are unrelated. Related activity only.
